resources.string: Grant permissions first, then open the floating controller. Currently supports single-point continuous clicking: you can pick a point, start, and stop clicking in any app via the side-floating controller.
Current click point (single): Not selected yet
The floating controller directly reads the following 3 values: actual wait time = base interval + random extra between 0 and the specified maximum.
Unit: milliseconds. Minimum wait between two clicks. 1000 ms = 1 second. Recommended to try between 300 and 800 first.
Unit: milliseconds. Adds a random delay between 0 and this value on top of base interval each time. Set to 0 for fixed rhythm, no randomness.
Set to 1 for single click; 10 for 10 clicks; 0 for infinite until manually stopped.
Single-point click mode. Target point: %1$s\nWait time per click: %2$d to %3$d ms\nTotal clicks: %4$s
Please enter valid configuration: base interval at least 100 ms, random extra and click count cannot be empty. Set click point via the + button on the floating controller.
The base interval you entered is below 100 ms; it will be automatically set to 100 ms when starting.

Instructions: After tapping \"Open Floating Controller\", a persistent floating ball appears on the side. Expand it to use + to pick a point, delete button to remove point, play button to start clicking, pause button to stop. When collapsed to the side, translucent point markers are automatically hidden.
Overlay permission must be granted first.
Floating controller displayed, usable in any app.
Floating controller displayed. Tap the target position directly to pick a point.
AutoTapper accessibility service must be enabled first.
Please select a click point via the + button on the floating controller first.
Please enter valid configuration: base interval at least 100 ms, random extra and click count cannot be empty.
Tap anywhere on screen to set a new click point
Global point-pick mode active. Tap the target location to update the single-point coordinate; a translucent orange marker will appear after completion.
Used to perform automatic click gestures in any app. Only works when you manually tap \"Start Clicking\" or the GO button on the floating controller.
Gesture cancelled by system, auto clicking stopped.
System refused to dispatch click gesture, please check target interface state.
Controller ready, can be expanded in any app.
Auto clicking in progress, expand controller to stop.
